sketch:
Observe: SVG bench with four instruments (balance, éprouvette graduée,
thermomètre, aimant); student drags one of six samples onto each
instrument in turn and reads off masse / volume / température /
attraction magnétique. A table auto-fills. Experiment: given a
"mystery" sample, student uses the instruments in any order to fill
its row. Evaluate: given only a filled row, student picks which of
three unknown samples it belongs to. Wrinkle: two samples have same
mass but different volume — introduces density qualitatively.
